items.title: 30:52 · Our first historical test examines fifteenth-century Portugal
items.detail: Our first historical test examines fifteenth-century Portugal between 1441 and 1486, drawn from Chapter 3 of The Original Power, titled Version 1.0: Initializing the Vector.

items.title: 31:02 · This case tests Prediction 1 Institutional production
items.detail: This case tests Prediction 1, Institutional production, and checks Refutation Standard 1 by auditing the exact calendar dates on which raids, royal tax collection, papal bulls, and racial chronicles appeared.

items.title: 31:14 · Begin with the material optimization problem confronting
items.detail: Begin with the material optimization problem confronting the Portuguese Crown and nobility in the early 1400s.

items.title: 31:21 · Following the Black Death and recurring European
items.detail: Following the Black Death and recurring European wars, Portugal faced severe domestic labor scarcity alongside rising elite demand for capital accumulation through maritime trade and sugar cultivation on Atlantic islands such as Madeira.

items.title: 31:34 · Inside Europe feudal extraction from domestic Christian
items.detail: Inside Europe, feudal extraction from domestic Christian peasants ran into hard structural friction: shared religious membership, customary legal protections, local village solidarity, and the constant threat of peasant flight or revolt.
